title: Integrate the live catalog end to end
objective: Prove the complete registry-to-prompt-to-provider-to-execution flow across add, update, disable, delete, re-enable, compact, and resume.
context: Complete one low-conflict slice of the accepted live skill catalog and cache-preserving design.
The worktree is shared and dirty; only owned_files may be modified.

source_evidence.note: Developer-context initial catalog and progressive disclosure inspiration.
Live discovery, visibility overrides, and skill lifecycle inspiration.

include: Build fakes/fixtures that exercise filesystem and MCP skills without live providers.
Verify snapshot/delta-before-user order, latest-registry rejection, and context epoch rebuild.
Cover same-name different-source skills and two-session isolation.
exclude: Do not weaken assertions to accommodate defects; report failures to the owning task.

implementation_steps: Create deterministic fixtures and request captures.
Run scenarios through actual Manager, QueryLoop, provider adapters, SkillTool, compaction, and session state.
Record any owner-task defect with a minimal reproduction.
acceptance_criteria: First turn sends a full snapshot before user.
Add/update/visibility changes upsert; disable/delete revoke; re-enable upserts.
Execution rejects stale or disabled calls immediately.
Compact/resume never reuse a cursor or loaded ledger whose messages are not visible.
risks: An integration task that fixes production code would recreate the cross-agent conflicts this plan is designed to prevent.
dispatch_prompt: Add end-to-end integration tests only for the complete live skill catalog lifecycle. Report production defects by owner task; do not patch them here.
notes_for_assignee: If verification exposes a defect in another owner's production file, report the exact failing test and owner task; do not patch across ownership boundaries.
